answer.text: A trust holding a portfolio of income-producing real estate assets; units listed

explanation.text: The Logic: REIT holds commercial real estate, distributes rentals to unit-holders. The Trap: Other statements mis-describe REITs. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XI, X-B, XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: REITs suit yield-focused PMS clients — ~6-8% distributions typical.
